_about: What the HUD says when no quest is active, and the story's title cards (core/quests.gd: lead, due_card). `leads`: the first entry whose `if` holds shows in the quest tracker, so the player always has a line saying where the story goes on. `cards`: shown once a save, top centre, for `seconds` (ui/hud.gd show_card); the flag seen:<id> records it. Conditions are quest conditions (core/quests.gd). The closing entries hold only while the Frostline is not built (the flag zone_built:frostline, core/quests.gd): when it lands, Moss's loaf takes over.

cards.title: The Starfall
cards.subtitle: The valley woodland, the morning after
cards.text: A star fell in the night, somewhere past the old stones. The path runs south over the bridge to the stone circle, and someone has left a sign there.

cards.title: The valley holds
cards.subtitle: Here the story rests, for now
cards.text: The lantern is lit, the well runs and the Ferns are home. The Col Path to the Frostline is still buried by the storm. The story goes on when it opens.
